_why_gate: Named rather than discovered: tools/ holds two compare_*.py, and picking the first alphabetically would run the right one by luck.
_why_warmup: MEASURED on this file, not carried over from the one it replaced (which also landed on 468): all 98 mismatches before it are the short-side arm stage - state the chart carries in from before the export began, which a cold Python cannot have - and all 19,668 bars after it match, with the export's final calendar day left out by the gate's own default.
_what_it_ran: Adding to winners ON at the shipped sub-settings (adds on the trailing stop, up to 3, each at most 0.5x the original, adds ride with the trade). Every other setting the export carries matches SosFadeConfig's defaults except the dead-market floor (0.3 on the chart, 0.08 in the bot) and, since 2026-09-13, risk per trade (10 on the chart, 5 as the default) - the gate reads risk off this export, and R does not depend on it. So this golden says NOTHING about the B leg, divergence arming or the no-gap fallback - the gate names the last one on every run.
_replaced: The 2026-09-10 export with adding to winners OFF (20,218 bars, 8 trades, +10.63R). The live bot adds, so this is the one that describes it; the OFF path stays covered by the B-LEG and BOS goldens, which run the same execution code with it off.
_exercise_check: 8 trades close inside the compared window on the chart, +12.62R; 5 of them added, 13 adds in all. Proven load-bearing: with adds forced off in the Python the gate goes RED at the first trade that added (bar 5,698, +2.40R against the chart's +2.59R).
_second_csv: VANTAGE_XAUUSD_M15_21074bars_scalein_stress.csv, taken 2026-09-24 off the Pine carrying the whole-position add sizing. A STRESS export, not a description of the live bot: adding to winners ON at 4 adds, a 2.0x per-add cap and the re-arm setting on 'Stop improved', risk 5, dead-market floor 0.08. 26 trades, 30 adds, +15.87R on the chart. It exists because the first golden CANNOT see the sizing fix: forcing the pre-fix sizing back on passes it.
